newsitem.title: CHINA: Pandas airlifted to U.S. for fertility tests.
newsitem.headline: Pandas airlifted to U.S. for fertility tests.

text.p: A pair of pandas has been airlifted from Shanghai to the San Diego Zoo for treatment for infertility, a Shanghai Zoo official said on Wednesday.
The pandas are a 15-year-old male named Shishi (Stone) and a five-year-old female named Baiyun (White Cloud), who is still a virgin.
Both came from the Wolong Protection Zone in southwest Sichuan Province. They left for San Diego on Tuesday, the official said.

There are about 100 pandas in Chinese zoos, and they gave birth to a total of only 12 babies between 1991 and 1995. It is estimated that about 1,000 of the animals exist in the wilds of central China.
